title: One CI run per merge: the merge tool rebuilds the records page before the ready run
why: shiv, Oct 31 14:12 CDT owner ask (via coordinator [ended:Claude-settings-coordinator-handoff]): second in work order. Owner figure: 25 of 80 merges in the week to Oct 31 needed a second CI run (not measured by triage). One second run measured at about 28 min (#882, Oct 30 20:10 CDT). FOURTH REPEAT 03:54 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:53, from runner 10's read of log merge3349b.log; unchecked by triage): `merge 3349 --confirm` refused a fully green ready PR because its generated records page went stale after main moved (#3279 landed); remedy is draft, records step, mark ready again, a second full CI (wall unmeasured; the "about 70 min, n=2" was recalled by runner 10, not read; other repos unmeasured). The owner asked twice to stop the double CI run (Oct 31 14:12 CDT; Nov 1 20:51 CST, per decision records-index-at-merge, read by triage on origin/main). Triage read of how often the page goes stale, CORRECTED 03:59 CST Nov 14 (my first read, "1 of 227 commits touched records, so only #3279-type merges trigger it", was WRONG: git log with default history simplification hid the pages that merge commits carry, on a shallow clone): for each "Merge pull request" commit on origin/main 4db2a9cf3, `git diff <first parent> <merge> -- docs/records.md`: since Nov 13 00:00 container time, the page differs from the first parent in 4 of 11 PR-merge commits found; since Nov 10, in 20 of 38. So about 4 in 11 to 1 in 2 merges change the committed page. The count is approximate: the log walk missed some merges (it did not list #3279 itself) and only "Merge pull request" commits are counted. Runner 10's git read (relayed 03:54, unchecked by triage): on main 4db2a9cf docs/records.md is identical to #3349's copy, last rebuilt by 81eaca3ad3 at 20:28 CST Nov 13, and none of the 43 main commits since #3349's base touched it, so the tool's "stale" means the generator's output for the merged tree differs, i.e. record files changed on main since 20:28 CST (generator not run by anyone). Runner 10's "most merges" is not borne out by my count (4/11 to 20/38), nor was my "rare". A ready PR is restarted when any records-changing merge lands before it. Stale-decision form (decision records-index-at-merge, sentence "That batch still runs CI twice (unmeasured in other repos; none in this repo, Oct 24 to 31)"): the "none in this repo" claim is unmeasured, not disproved: the 70 min was recalled, not read (see the correction below). Outcome the decision protects: main's records page current; what protects it now: the main-side check (lint/hook_catalog.py --check), and PR CI already waives a stale page (the coordinator's read). Fix to propose, in the order of least change: (a) the merge tool rebuilds the page in the merge commit, or (b) a main-side refresh PR after a records change, so a ready PR is never restarted; (c) the merge tool refuses stale and the remedy stays (today). Whether (a) breaks the tested-tree claim of push-skip-proven-tree (main's tree differs from the PR's tested tree by the page) is the lane's first read. Consultant evidence 04:06 CST Nov 14 (consultant 04:06; its read, unchecked by triage; owner priority fb-1556-6): #3349 was green at 03:51 (66 jobs); the ready mark refused on a stale docs/records.md; the records step pushed one generated-page commit (3128df369c); the whole CI ran again (about 35 min). Same on #3373. Fix candidates the consultant names: (i) CI scope reads a push whose only difference from the last green head is the generated records page as docs-only and reuses the green run; (ii) generate the page at merge on main, not on the PR. Wider class named: every generated-file commit (refs blocks, gen blocks, stamp claims) pushed onto a green PR. Triage note: candidate (i) is not one of item 830's two options, and it also widens a guard (CI scope); candidate (ii) is the rebuild-at-merge route the lane read as out (the merge tool's API merge cannot change the tree). The lane should read (i) and say if item 830 needs a third option; triage has not changed item 830. Lane read on the consultant's candidate (i), 04:09 CST Nov 14 (via the coordinator 04:08; the lane read .github/scripts/ci-scope.sh whole and grepped checks.yml lines 7, 21-27, 102, 143; unchecked by triage): (1) as stated (i) cannot work: ci-scope.sh diffs $BASE_SHA...HEAD (line 17), the whole PR, never the push. (2) No reuse found: a new head triggers a new run (synchronize, cancel-in-progress on PRs); not read: whether another job reuses an earlier result. (3) Form (i') would work: ci-scope.sh takes the push's before sha (github.event.before), checks the before head's run was fully green and the delta is docs/records.md alone, then sets every flag false; all-jobs-passed counts skipped jobs as pass. Files: ci-scope.sh, checks.yml, lint/test_ci_scope.py. A guard change on the script's own fail-safe list: round 3 and net-value apply. Gain unmeasured (flagged-false jobs still start and skip). Posted as option c on owner item 830, a widening, no star. The lane also closed the red-checkout question by decision lanes-start-in-tool-worktrees (owner 2026-10-21): worktrees come only from the Agent tool's isolation or EnterWorktree. The record-edit-only draft PR starts from main 48728d122. Read by REST on #3349's head 1d8ce9406: full checks runs 43579044324 (41 min) and 43564208386 (51 min), neither after the records step; the run after it is 43583006785 (head 3128df369c, started 09:58:07Z, in progress; runner 10 sends its wall at its end). Owner item 830 is corrected to match. Record PR #3396 (the decision record text, now the measured sentence): head 2a9d7db8ffb1 (ls-remote 04:49), record comments 6875844870 (older head 4ba2adefc) and 6876137213 (live head: round 1 haiku PASS, fix check sonnet PASS), one file, draft, ste_lint PASS per the lane (coordinator 04:49, unchecked by triage). Data point 05:14 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:15, runner 10's `--reviewed` log at 05:13; not read by triage; the cost not timed): the records step on draft #3377 (merge-lint-skip-green-rollup) pushed a records-page commit, head 732293c9b3 to 8c4dfb4219ed, and so made the review record stale; #3377 now waits on a fix check at 8c4dfb4219ed, asked of lane merge-tool-audit-fixes. For #3349 the records step did not make it stale (docs-only). So for a guard or check PR the records step adds a new head, a lane lint cycle and a fix check (runner 10's wording). A data point for the records-page choice (owner item 830), not a ruling. Sample 05:28 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:29, runner 11's read; logs /tmp/verdict-slx057ah.log and /tmp/verdict-mlxpcw9w.log, read by neither the coordinator nor triage): degen #718 hit the records-page refusal on a ready PR, the first time in degen. Remedy followed: draft, `merge 718 --confirm` on the draft pushed the records page (head 0d3422ed to b937d1bed), marked ready 05:28 CST. The green run on 0d3422ed no longer covers the new head, so full CI runs again: the last degen run took 14 min and mutation-report 9 min 48 s (n=1). Runner 11 suggests lanes pre-run `merge <pr> --confirm` on their draft before hand-in; the coordinator notes the page goes stale again whenever another merge lands first (about 1 merge in 3 to 1 in 2 by triage's approximate count), so a pre-run saves the second CI only when main does not move first. A process change, so not told to any lane; owner item 830 is open and carries this sample.
note: Placed ahead of c52 and every other open step but trust-card-guard: owner ask, Oct 31 14:12 CDT. Lane open, draft #895; it waits on batch 37, which also edits merge/merge.py. Cause: merge/merge.py (commit_claim) adds a 'Claim record numbers' commit and a 'Rebuild the records page' commit after the PR's ready run, and the push starts CI again. Fix: claim the numbers and rebuild docs/records.md before the PR goes ready, so the ready run is the only run. Guard rule records-page still keeps lanes from committing docs/records.md; the merge tool does it. Lane finding 03:57 (its reads of files, nothing run; unchecked by triage): fix (a) is OUT: push-skip-on-proven-tree needs main's tree to equal the PR head's tree (push-skip.py `decide`), and the merge tool's API merge cannot change the tree. Fix (b) deadlocks as is (main's own lint/hook_catalog.py --check fails a stale page on a push to main; a red main lets only a revert merge). Narrowed (b): 1) `merge --confirm` on a ready green PR stops refusing when the only difference is a page stale because main gained records, merges as is, pushes nothing; 2) the tool then opens a draft refresh PR (one per records change); 3) main's --check waives that case on a push to main only while the page differs by records the last merge brought. That narrowed (b) removes a refusal and adds a waiver on a check: a guard widening, so an owner pick (item 830). Lane meanwhile writes the red test and the decision-record edit only; no merge.py or hook_catalog.py change until the owner picks.
